chapter: King Oliver, own trio and Kirby
title: Trumpeters in Oliver's band: Red Elkins
summary: Moore recalls second trumpeter Red Elkins from Washington as staying almost to the end.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Do you recall one of the trumpeters who came into the King Oliver band by the name of Leonard Phillips? This would be about 1933 or '32.
Well, now, there was one whose name was Red...
No, not Red Allen. Another Red. Red Elkins.
Yeah. He's from... I think he's from Washington, D.C.
I had this... Yeah, he's from Washington.
He lived in Washington, on 1731 Willard Street, NW.
He was a nice little trumpet player, too.
How long did he stay with Oliver and that band?
Oh, he played with him almost til he passed away.
